translations.web: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
translations.bsb: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
translations.kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
translations.asv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
